name: Paris Piano Collective
description: A friendly collective of student pianists. Weekly open jams, classical nights and workshops for every level — from first chords to Debussy.

name: Seine Runners
description: Run along the Seine with other students. Easy 5k on Wednesdays, long runs on Sundays, and a pastry stop at the end. Always.

name: Street Photo Paris
description: Photo walks through Paris neighbourhoods, critique sessions and a yearly exhibition. Phones welcome, film cameras celebrated.

name: Chess & Coffee
description: Casual chess over good coffee. Blitz tournaments every month, beginners' corner every week.

name: Climbing Crew Paris
description: Bouldering sessions after class and weekend trips to Fontainebleau. Shoes can be borrowed for your first session.

name: Jazz Lovers 13e
description: Live jazz nights, jam sessions and listening clubs. The one-time fee covers the rehearsal room for the year.

name: Indie Game Makers
description: Build small games together. Game jams every two months, Godot and Unity workshops, playtest evenings.

name: Salsa Nights
description: Salsa and bachata classes for beginners followed by a social dance night. No partner needed.

name: Urban Sketchers
description: We draw the city, on location, one sketch at a time. Meet-ups every Saturday morning near a monument.

name: Debate Society
description: Weekly debates on tech, politics-free society topics and philosophy. Great to practise public speaking in English and French.
